_comment: Where the pstack plugin comes from and the exact commit the evaluation runs on. `dotctl pstack setup` fetches this commit into a local checkout outside the repository and loads `pluginDir` with `claude --plugin-dir`; nothing from upstream is copied into this repository. Move the pin deliberately: upstream rewrites skills daily, and the evaluation compares against one version.

fixes.why: Claude Code cannot invoke a skill whose name has a space (cursor/plugins#237); upstream fix PR #619 is open
